scope: Two original HUE tasks in the frozen three-turn private case; whole goal remains active

HUE1.1.covered: Provisional person hypothesis preserves source/uncertainty, actual counterinformation creates a same-kind linked successor, and the next relevant ordinary answer changes while retaining qualification and private-person scope.
HUE1.1.boundary: One synthetic private person was exercised. This is not a new multi-person behavioral privacy guarantee or household acceptance.

HUE3.1.covered: Prospective expectation has source/uncertainty/review time; later user-reported outcome explicitly refutes it with paired provenance and changes the next ordinary answer without certainty/authority promotion.
HUE3.1.boundary: The outcome is the synthetic user report, not an independent physical observation.
